MonoBrowser 0.6.0

- New compact single-row tab bar, plus an optional vertical tab sidebar (resizable, collapsible to icons)
- Compact mode (`Ctrl+Shift+C`): the tab bar or sidebar hides and slides in when the pointer reaches the window edge
- Split view: show two tabs side by side with a draggable divider; drag a tab onto the page to split
- Spaces: separate sets of tabs with their own icon, name and colour (`Ctrl+Alt+1`…`9`)
- Glance: preview a link in a floating overlay without opening a new tab (`Alt+click` by default, configurable)
- One theme for the whole browser: Default (follows system light/dark), 14 presets (Rosé Pine, Everforest, Gruvbox, Nord, Dracula, Tokyo Night, Solarized, Kanagawa, One Dark) and a custom theme editor
- Smooth animations across the interface, with an on/off switch
- Settings, history, downloads, site data, statistics and the new About page open as tabs instead of separate windows
- Styled error pages, a certificate warning page, and in-window prompts for site permissions, HTTP sign-in and "Leave site?"
- Per-site content blocking exceptions from the site information popup and Settings
- Session restore on startup, per-site zoom with a zoom indicator, link preview in the status bar, audio indicator with mute, loading progress bar, HTML5 fullscreen, spellcheck suggestions, and drag and drop of links and files
- New shortcuts: `Ctrl+P`, `Ctrl+S`, `Ctrl+U`, `Ctrl+1`…`9`, `Ctrl+Shift+M` (notes)
- Experimental settings: RAM limiter, CPU limiter, and user scripts
- First-run welcome screen with language, theme, layout and privacy choices
- Electron updated to 44.9.0 and the Ghostery adblocker engine to 2.20.1

Downloads:
- Windows: `MonoBrowser-Setup-0.6.0.exe`
- Linux: `MonoBrowser-0.6.0-x86_64.AppImage`
